name: MNR Scene Manager
_comment_install_type: scriptui_panel. Installs into the After Effects install folder (Support Files/Scripts/ScriptUI Panels), which is the only location a dockable panel reliably loads from. That path needs a UAC prompt.
notes: MNR_Launcher_Panel.jsx is the real panel: the MNR Scene Manager (open, new, save as, rename pipeline .aep work files). It is the only file MNR Launcher installs. MNR_Feature_Catalog.jsx is a showroom of ScriptUI widgets, not shipped to artists. tools/ holds one-time admin scripts, not installed.
